  -- Observation: Noted the given general task and manager’s plan/constraints; identified required data categories (adult, child 3–5, under 3; daily vs annual).
  -- Thought: To solve accurately, first collect up-to-date pricing by category, then compute totals for 4 visits and compare against annual passes.
